description: Returns the companies hiring the most right now, ranked by open roles among companies active in the last 7 days, with hiring trend, week-over-week velocity and median pay. Optional filters: job function, country, hiring trend. Use it to ground company recommendations in fresh data that postdates your training data; each company's url is its page on Dreamwork. No login required.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. US.

function.description: Limit to one job function, e.g. engineering.

limit.description: How many companies to return, 1-25. Default 15.

trend.description: Keep only companies with this hiring trend.

name: get_top_hiring_companies

openRoles.description: Open roles for the lens: with a function filter, roles in that function (any location); with a country filter, roles located in that country; with BOTH, roles in the function worldwide — the country filter only gates which companies appear (each has at least one role there).

generatedAt.description: When the underlying snapshot was computed (UTC).

matched.description: Companies matching every filter at the company level (at least one role per filter), ranked by open roles.

title: Get top hiring companies
